'''Levanger Fotballklubb''' is a Norwegian [[football (soccer)|football]] club located in [[Levanger Municipality]]. The club currently plays in the [[2. divisjon]], the third tier of the [[Norwegian football league system]]. Founded 20 May 1996, Levanger FK is the result of a merger between [[SK Nessegutten]] and IL Sverre."}}
